species.name: Wild Horse
mustRead: stiff upright brush mane with no forelock
stocky barrel body on short legs
large heavy head
species.note: Read as Przewalski's horse: dun coat, erect mane, dark dorsal stripe. Not a slender domestic riding horse with a flowing mane.

species.name: Wild Ass
mustRead: very long upright ears
erect short mane
tufted cow-like tail with a bare upper half

species.name: Camel
mustRead: hump on the back
long curving neck held high
very long knobbly-kneed legs
species.note: Generic name read as a representative dromedary. Taller than most people draw: the leg mass is roughly half the total height.

species.name: Yak
mustRead: curtain of long hair hanging to the ground along the flanks
humped shoulders and low-carried head
bushy horse-like tail plume

species.name: Hamster
mustRead: rounded neckless body
almost no visible tail
bulging cheek pouches and blunt short muzzle

species.name: Agama
mustRead: large blunt triangular head
tail about as long as the body
sprawled legs with the belly held clear of the ground

species.name: Maned Wolf
mustRead: absurdly long stilt legs with black stockings
very large erect ears
dark mane along the neck and shoulders
species.note: The legs are the whole point: leg length is roughly 60% of standing height, far leggier than any fox or wolf. Body itself is small and slim.

species.name: Pampas Fox
mustRead: pointed narrow muzzle with large triangular ears
long bushy dark-tipped tail carried low
grizzled grey back with tawny legs

species.name: Armadillo
mustRead: hinged bands of armour across the middle of the back
long pointed snout with small tubular ears
tapering armoured tail

species.name: Agouti
mustRead: arched hunched back rising to the rump
slender delicate legs with hoof-like claws
essentially no tail

species.name: Guinea Pig
mustRead: tailless loaf-shaped body
very short legs almost hidden by the belly
blunt rounded muzzle with drooping petal ears

species.name: Tegu
mustRead: massive jowled blocky head
heavy banded body with beaded scales
thick tail slightly longer than the body

species.name: Cattle
mustRead: deep barrel body with a straight level back
broad blunt muzzle and sideways-set horns
tufted rope tail hanging to the hocks
species.note: Generic name read as a representative domestic cow.

species.name: Sheep
mustRead: thick woolly fleece blurring the body outline
narrow bare face and legs sticking out of the fleece
short drooping tail

species.name: Goat
mustRead: backward-sweeping horns
chin beard
short upright tail flicked up over the rump
species.note: Unlike a sheep the tail points up, the coat is flat, and the profile of the face is straighter and narrower.

species.name: Alpine Salamander
mustRead: glossy jet-black moist skin
blunt rounded head with bulging eyes
short sprawling legs and a rounded tail

species.name: Wall Lizard
mustRead: tail roughly twice the body length
flattened slender body pressed to the surface
long splayed toes

species.name: Wild Pony
mustRead: short stocky legs under a deep round barrel
thick shaggy mane and forelock over the eyes
small head with a broad forehead
species.note: Pony proportions differ from a horse: legs are short relative to body depth, so the silhouette is longer and lower.

species.name: Lizard
mustRead: tail longer than the body
four legs splayed sideways with elbows out
wedge-shaped scaly head
species.note: Generic name read as a representative small lacertid lizard. Limbs sprawl out to the side, not underneath the body like a mammal.

species.name: Whiptail
mustRead: extremely long thin tail two to three times the body
slender pointed snout
pale stripes running the length of the back

species.name: Dromedary Camel
mustRead: single hump
long curved neck rising from sloped shoulders
long legs with knobbly knee pads and splayed padded feet

species.name: Fennec Fox
mustRead: gigantic triangular ears nearly as long as the head
tiny slender pale body
black-tipped bushy tail
species.note: The ears alone can be a third of the standing height; undersized ears turn it into an ordinary fox.

species.name: Sand Cat
mustRead: broad flattened head with low wide-set ears
short stocky legs with furred feet
banded tail with a black tip

species.name: Striped Hyena
mustRead: back sloping steeply down from high shoulders to low hips
erect crest of long mane hair along the spine
large pointed ears and a heavy blunt muzzle
species.note: Front legs are noticeably longer than the hind legs; the sloping topline is the defining read.
